mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guide ( id, city, year, edition, guide_type, collection, status, director, director_role, cover_headline1, cover_headline2, cover_tagline, cover_photo_url, cover_bg_color, primary_color, accent_color, directors_letter, director_photo_url, director_pull_quote, director_signature, mission_text, criteria_list, persona_name, persona_tagline, persona_photo_url, persona_body_photo_url, persona_bio, persona_quote, persona_awards, sections_config, back_cover_config, owner_user_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{city}, #{year}, #{edition}, #{guideType}, #{collection}, #{status}, #{director}, #{directorRole}, #{coverHeadline1}, #{coverHeadline2}, #{coverTagline}, #{coverPhotoUrl}, #{coverBgColor}, #{primaryColor}, #{accentColor}, #{directorsLetter}, #{directorPhotoUrl}, #{directorPullQuote}, #{directorSignature}, #{missionText}, #{criteriaList, typeHandler=com.alibaba.fastjson.support.spring.FastjsonTypeHandler}, #{personaName}, #{personaTagline}, #{personaPhotoUrl}, #{personaBodyPhotoUrl}, #{personaBio}, #{personaQuote}, #{personaAwards, typeHandler=com.alibaba.fastjson.support.spring.FastjsonTypeHandler}, #{sectionsConfig, typeHandler=com.alibaba.fastjson.support.spring.FastjsonTypeHandler}, #{backCoverConfig, typeHandler=com.alibaba.fastjson.support.spring.FastjsonTypeHandler}, #{ownerUserId}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM guide WHERE city = #{city} AND year = #{year} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM guide WHERE owner_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
